## Work

At Shohoz he builds backend and full-stack systems for national-scale bus, train, flight, and event booking. Lorapok Labs is a 20+ product open-source studio covering AI agents, Laravel packages, media engines, Bangla NLP, and developer tooling.

## Skills

PHP/Laravel, JavaScript, TypeScript, React, Node.js, MySQL, REST APIs, Android, C#/.NET, Python, Unity, DevOps, LLM/AI.
